data.long_description:
Experience elevated waterfront living at Trillionaire Residences by Binghatti, an iconic residential address set along the tranquil canal in the heart of Business Bay. This ultra-luxury development redefines modern urban living through bold architectural expression, refined interiors, and a lifestyle designed for those who expect nothing but excellence.

The tower’s striking sculptural façade showcases Binghatti’s signature avant-garde design, blending sharp geometric lines with fluid forms to create a landmark that stands out on Dubai’s skyline. Every detail reflects sophistication—from the thoughtfully designed living spaces to the seamless integration of comfort, technology, and sustainability.

Trillionaire Residences is more than a home; it is a statement of prestige. Designed for discerning residents, the development combines exclusivity, privacy, and resort-style living while remaining minutes away from Dubai’s most vibrant destinations. Sustainable technologies and eco-conscious systems are carefully incorporated, ensuring luxury living that is both responsible and future-focused.

Features: 

Iconic waterfront residential tower
Contemporary, high-end architectural design
Elegant interiors with premium finishes
Smart home integration for modern living
Floor-to-ceiling windows maximizing natural light
Sustainable and energy-efficient building systems
Exclusive lifestyle-focused development
Prime location in Business Bay
Amenities:

Infinity swimming pool overlooking the canal
Fully equipped state-of-the-art gym
Spa and wellness facilities
Residents’ lounge and social spaces
Landscaped outdoor areas
24/7 security and concierge services
Covered parking
High-speed elevators
